title: Compatibility questionnaire

intro.title: Forty-five questions to find your chemistry
intro.lead: Values, lifestyle, campus, humour and plans. About ten minutes, saved as you go: stop and come back whenever you like.
intro.how1: Your answer: what sounds like you.
intro.how2: What you accept from the other person: one or more answers.
intro.how3: Importance: the higher it is, the more the question weighs in the score.
intro.privacy: Your answers are never shown as such. Only what you have in common appears, and only to people who can see your profile.

acceptable: What you accept from the other person
acceptableHint: Tick every answer that works for you.

importanceHelp.irrelevant: This question does not count in your score.
importanceHelp.somewhat: It counts ten times more than "a little".
importanceHelp.very: It counts fifty times more than "a little".
importanceHelp.mandatory: Dealbreaker: people who don't match will not be suggested to you. Keep it for what really matters.

keyboardHint: Tip: keys 1 to 4 to answer, Enter to continue.

done.title: All done
done.lead: Your answers are saved. Compatibility percentages now show on profiles, along with what you have in common.
